name: Corvane Emergency Fuel Price Order

components.cap_unit: dollars a gallon, regular grade, Day 5 to Day 95
source_sentences: Regular gasoline sold at retail in Corvane is capped at $4.20 a gallon including taxes, midgrade at $4.50 and premium at $4.80, from Day 5 to Day 95.
On Day 3 the governor announced that a cap would take effect on Day 5.
Enforcement is funded by an emergency appropriation from the general fund.

unclear.text: Whether stations may limit the quantity sold per customer, shorten their opening hours or refuse card payments.

context: Before the outage, regular gasoline averaged $3.90 a gallon in Corvane. By Day 3 it was $5.10. In Brennick it was about $4.00.
The eastern Corvane cities are 20 to 45 minutes' drive from the Brennick line.
